Ethan Support: heads-up - Brightline (BR-998) onboarding stuck. Activation emails bouncing after SSO config. Ticket created: https://redwood.zd/ticket/67890
Priya CS: thanks. Renewal window? who is CSM? @Jordan
Ethan Support: renewal in ~55 days. Jordan is listed as CSM. They're in an enterprise eval with 3 teams.
Jordan CS Manager: on it. can you paste the exact error & metadata used?
Ethan Support: logs snippet:
```
SAML Error: Assertion consumer URL mismatch
SP metadata: https://sso.brightline.com/metadata.xml
```
Ethan Support: attempted reprovisioning, same result. IdP team says they will push a config fix; ETA ~3h.
Priya CS: quick comms plan: 1) warm transfer to CS in 20m, 2) send customer-safe status + technical note to IdP admins, 3) schedule enablement for tomorrow AM PST. Jordan, can you take the handoff?
Jordan CS Manager: I will. Jordan -> actions: create shared invite, add triage notes in account, set goal: all trial seats live by EOD tomorrow. I'll rope in Solutions for a fallback.
Sam Solutions: drafting a fallback runbook (short):
- toggle relaxed NameID validation in test env
- run `redwood auth refresh --tenant BR-998 --force`
- verify with `curl -i https://app.brightline.com/_status`
I'll post draft in #eng-platform for quick review.
Ava AE: pinging AE thread 1 to prep renewal outreach if onboarding slips. Got their exec sponsor contact.
Priya CS: I'll write two templates: one concise ops note for IdP admins and one customer-friendly status. Ethan please send the customer-safe message now: "We're investigating an SSO provisioning issue; temporary workaround and scheduled call forthcoming." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ethan Support: sent at 4032110180. Customer replied: "thanks, we'll be ready for a morning call PST." :thumbsup:
Jordan CS Manager: next steps recap: Jordan to warm-transfer now; Sam to publish fallback doc; Priya to log renewal watch and create 7-day touch cadence; Ava to prep AE outreach if no progress in 24h. I'll mark account health: At-risk (onboarding).
Priya CS: capturing feedback: onboarding docs missing IdP example snippets and NameID guidance. Add to product feedback board.
OpsBot: Task created: BR-998-warm-transfer assigned to Jordan, due 4032110780.
Priya CS: I'll post a follow-up summary after the enablement call. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
